verdict.rationale: First-party SDK docs have a dedicated MCP page. They state that agents can connect MCP servers to query databases and integrate with services like Slack and GitHub without custom tool code. Servers can run as local processes, connect over HTTP, or run in-process within the SDK app, and the shared Claude Code foundation adds broad MCP connectivity and admin-managed server controls. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP integration works as documented in the SDK.
